web-content-0d79ef9997d8.d09fc114294424f: On a one-on-one listing, opening "Book" takes you into checkout on the same page — you do not leave to a separate site. The available slots come from the creator's own calendar: their working hours, how long each session runs, and how much notice they need before a booking. Only slots that are actually open show up; a time they have already blocked out, or one too close to now, will not appear.
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.b2776291d78af5e: Checkout asks for your email and a one-time code — no password to set. Once you confirm, the listing price plus GST is paid from your token balance or through the payment option you pick, and held in
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.b420ccdec528918: for what a token is worth. Nothing is charged twice, and nothing is deducted per minute while the session runs — the whole price is settled one way or the other only after the session is over.
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.78d4314a2c93380: Right after payment you land on a confirmation screen with a link straight into your session room, and the booking is always visible afterwards from "All my bookings" in your dashboard.
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.4431c3133513484: A booked 1:1 session runs in your browser at its own web address (no app required to attend). Before you're let into the call, avaTOK runs a quick preflight check of your camera, microphone and speaker so a broken device doesn't surprise you mid-session. Once that passes, you're placed in the session and see a waiting screen until the creator joins too — you are never billed extra for the time spent waiting.
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.259b6abe5349107: What decides whether the creator gets paid
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.e3a13096a570d59: avaTOK does not charge by the minute. Once the session's time window has passed, the system looks at whether both of you were actually present together for a meaningful stretch of the call:
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.f3b85400149ec51: If you and the creator were both present, the creator is paid and the tokens leave escrow.
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.c3b7990054c0273: If the creator never showed up in any meaningful way, you are refunded in full.
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.094699496615f79: If the creator was there and you didn't join, the session counts as delivered and the creator is paid.
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.6a3a5f009c442c9: There is currently no partial/pro-rata charge for a session that ran short — it is one of those two outcomes. For the exact refund rules by situation (creator no-show, buyer no-show, cancellation), see
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.641c51cde2fdea8: A note on where we are today
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.5c0cfb9c52ba43c: avaTOK's payments are still in a testing phase with a small number of invited users (see
web-content-0d79ef9997d8.e32ee7314113be1: ) — if anything is charged in error, support will refund it in full.
